Birthday Parties

Celebrate with a sewing party.

Bring your group to the studio for a creative birthday celebration.

A party they will remember.

Birthday parties at Sew Essentials are built around the fun of making something with your hands. Tell us about your guest of honor and your ideas, and we will follow up with the details and what is available.

  • Send a request with your preferred date
  • We follow up to discuss options and confirm
  • Questions? Call 240-698-0342
Submitting this form is a request. A date is held only once the studio confirms with you.
Party types

A party for every age group.

Kids' parties

Ages 6 to 12. About 2 to 3 hours. Simple, fun projects like felt bookmarks, mini tote bags or fabric headbands. Pre-cut fabric, sewing kits, embellishments and child-friendly sewing machines or hand-sewing supplies are provided.

Ideal for birthdays with hands-on creativity

Teen parties

Ages 13 to 18. About 3 to 4 hours. Slightly bigger projects such as custom pillowcases, tote bags, or simple skirts and T-shirts. Fabrics, sewing machines, sewing kits, embellishments and pattern templates are provided.

Great for stylish, skill-building celebrations

Adult parties

Ages 18 and over. About 3 to 4 hours. More advanced projects such as personalized aprons, home decor or custom clothing pieces. High-quality fabrics, sewing machines, full sewing kits and pattern options are provided.

Perfect for creative gatherings and special occasions
Every party includes

The basic package.

  • Customizable digital invitations
  • All the sewing supplies and materials for the chosen project
  • An experienced sewing instructor to guide everyone
  • Decorations to match your theme
  • Light snacks and drinks
Cake is not included. Parties can also suit team-building events and other get-togethers. Ask us for details.
